crossRefs.note: They have hands, but they don’t feel. They have feet, but they don’t walk, neither do they speak through their throat.

translations.web: They have hands, but they don’t feel. They have feet, but they don’t walk, neither do they speak through their throat.
translations.bsb: they have hands, but cannot feel; they have feet, but cannot walk; they cannot even clear their throats.
translations.kjv: They have hands, but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat.
translations.asv: They have hands, but they handle not; Feet have they, but they walk not; Neither speak they through their throat.
